units: <cite ref="Pesachim 20b:19">Pes. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ראוי לז׳</he> (Ms. O. through entire page <cite ref="G00502"><he>זֶלֶף</he></cite>) fit for sprinkling.
<cite ref="Pesachim 20b:23">Ib.</cite> <he>תֵּעָשֶׂה ז׳</he> may be used for &c.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>יזלו</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:16">Cant. IV, 16</cite>) <he>זה ז׳</he> that means aromatic sprinkling.

<cite ref="Sukkah 40b">Succ. 40ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 102a:3">B. Kam. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>לאכלה ולא לז׳</he> ‘to be eaten’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 25:6">Lev. XXV, 6</cite>) but not to be used for perfumes; v. <cite ref="G00489"><he>זֶלַח</he></cite>.
